english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something breaks open from internal pressure.
Use 爆 for something that cracks, splits, or bursts open, especially under pressure or from heat.
Use this for something bursting, blowing a tire or engine, or suddenly failing, rather than for a deliberate explosion.

examples.english: The balloon burst on its own.
